summary.text: Reuben D'Silva is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 28 who has served since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A U.S. Marine Corps veteran and history teacher, he is vice chair of the Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: D'Silva was born in Mumbai, India, served in the U.S. Marine Corps and graduated from Rancho High School in 2003.

He earned an A.A. from the College of Southern Nevada, a B.A. in history from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, an M.A. in globalization studies from the University of Pennsylvania, and an M.A. in comparative religion and politics from Yale University.

His career experience includes working as a history teacher at Rancho High School, and he has been affiliated with the Military Order of the Purple Heart, the Knights of Columbus and Veterans of Foreign Wars.
D'Silva assumed office on November 9, 2022, succeeding Edgar Flores.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Education Committee as vice chair, and to the Government Affairs and Revenue committees.
